exitSearch.result: No later Unison platform sale, recapitalization, Tiger exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified. Tiger's current portfolio page, post-close board governance and the August 2026 owned-EaaS contract support continuing active ownership and operations.

responseSourceHealthCorrections: The Federal Register URL redirects direct command-line retrieval to an access-control page; the exact filing was independently browser-retrieved and is not dead.
